Annotate SingleCellExperiment class object with pseudotime and path information.

Source: R/annotate_sce.R
annotate_sce.Rd

annotate_sce() annotates a SingleCellExperiment class object with pseudotime and path information in its cell.metadata generated using colData from the SingleCellExperiment package.

annotate_sce(
  sce,
  ptime_col = "Pseudotime",
  path_prefix = "Path",
  root_label = "root",
  path_col = path_prefix,
  exist_ptime_col = NULL,
  exist_path_col = NULL,
  labels_exist = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment object to be annotated.

ptime_col

A character string representing the column name for inferred Pseudotime values. (Default is "Pseudotime")

path_prefix

Prefix used to annotate the paths. (Default is "Path").

root_label

Label used to annotate root cells. (Default is "root").

path_col

A character string representing the column name for branching path assignment. (Default is path_prefix)

exist_ptime_col

The name of an existing pseudotime column to be replaced (if not NULL).

exist_path_col

The name of an existing path column to be replaced (if not NULL).

labels_exist

Logical indicating whether if the existing column names should be overwritten. (Default is TRUE)

verbose

Print detailed output in the console. (Default is TRUE)

Value

A SingleCellExperiment object with updated cell metadata.

See also

SingleCellExperiment package.
